_readme: Every video the game can show. A SCENE is what the game plays; SHOTS are the 5-8s micro-clips that get stitched into it. Charts are NEVER generated as video — AI video cannot draw an accurate candlestick and a wrong chart teaches the wrong thing. Charts stay code-drawn SVG (src/scenes/Scenes.jsx). Video is atmosphere only: arc openers, characters, ambience.

style.look: cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, limited 2-colour palette (deep indigo night + hot crimson accents), Studio Ghibli meets shonen title card, painterly backgrounds, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO charts, NO UI
style.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, charts, candlestick charts, graphs, stock tickers, photorealism, live action, gore, weapons pointed at viewer, brand logos
style.camera: slow deliberate moves only — push in, slow pan, gentle parallax. No whip pans, no rapid cuts inside a shot.
style._audio_note: Native model audio doubles the price and the game already has a full Web Audio score. Generate silent, score in the app.

scenes.use: Plays once before Arc 1's first lesson page

shots.prompt: A young trainee in a dark blue gi stands at the foot of a mountain dojo staircase at dusk, paper lanterns lighting each step upward, cherry petals drifting. Slow push in from behind their shoulder. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

A great white owl with wise amber eyes perched on a wooden dojo beam turns its head toward camera and slowly blinks, lantern light warming its feathers, dust motes floating. Slow gentle push in. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

Two hands clasp in a handshake over a low wooden table in a lantern-lit room, sealing an agreement, steam rising from a tea cup beside them. Slow tilt up from the hands. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Before Arc 2 (candles) — the candle as a battle, never an actual chart

shots.prompt: A single tall paper lantern candle burning in a dark dojo hall, flame steady, then leaning as unseen wind pushes it. Slow push in on the flame. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

Two silhouetted sumo-like figures locked shoulder to shoulder pushing against each other in a lantern-lit ring, neither winning, dust kicking up around their feet. Slow orbit around them. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

One figure suddenly drives the other backward across the ring in a burst of dust and lantern sparks, the crowd's silhouettes reacting. Slow pull back. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Before Arc 3 (trend) — the river, the game's core trend metaphor

shots.prompt: A wide mountain river rushing downstream through a forested valley at golden hour, seen from above, water catching light. Slow drift downstream with the current. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

A small wooden boat carried easily downstream by the current, its young pilot relaxed with the oar resting across their knees. Slow tracking shot alongside. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

The same small boat turned to face upstream, its pilot straining hard against the current and barely moving, spray flying off the oar. Slow push in on the strain. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Before Arc 4 (risk) — the shield and the one life

shots.prompt: A young trainee carefully fastens a worn leather bracer and shield strap in a quiet armoury before dawn, breath visible in the cold. Slow push in on the hands working the buckle. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

A round wooden shield takes a heavy unseen impact and holds, splinters and sparks flying off its rim, the bearer braced behind it. Slow push in. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

A single glowing paper lantern held in cupped hands in a vast dark field, its small light protected from the wind. Slow pull back revealing the darkness around it. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Volatility Dragon mission intro + the dragon badge unlock

shots.prompt: An enormous storm dragon made of churning grey cloud and crimson lightning coils above a mountain dojo, its head lowering toward the viewer, rain lashing sideways. Slow low-angle push in. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Arc 8 (hype) intro + the Hype Demon reveal

shots.prompt: A grinning masked trickster spirit in a flashy gold-trimmed haori tosses glittering coins that turn to dead leaves the moment they leave its hand, carnival lanterns behind it. Slow push in on the grin. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

A great white owl mentor on a dojo beam slowly nods once with approval, eyes warm, gold sparks drifting up around it. Locked-off shot, subtle motion only. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

An ornate wooden treasure chest bound in iron sits in a dark dojo storeroom; its lid bursts open and golden light and coins erupt upward. Locked-off shot centred on the chest. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Seamless loop behind the Quest Map, 25% opacity, muted

shots.prompt: Empty mountain dojo courtyard at night, paper lanterns swaying gently, cherry petals drifting across still air, distant stars. Locked-off wide shot, minimal motion, seamless loop. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

scenes.use: Seamless loop behind lesson cards, 20% opacity, muted

shots.prompt: Interior of a wooden dojo hall lit by hanging paper lanterns, warm light flickering on beams, dust motes drifting slowly. Locked-off shot, minimal motion, seamless loop. Cel-shaded anime, bold ink outlines, indigo and crimson palette.

_todo: Arcs 5-10 openers follow the same 3-shot shape (metaphor → problem → consequence). Author them only after arcs 1-4 come back looking right — no point buying 18 more clips against an unproven style.
